title.zh: 规划（国家公园局土地开发授权）公告
title.en: Planning (Development of Land Authorisation for National Parks Board) Notification

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Planning (Development of Land Authorisation for National Parks Board) Notification
3. Subject to paragraph 4, the operations involving the development of land in any park by the National Parks Board for any park facility are authorised under section 21(6) of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Park facility
1. Barbecue pit
2. Basketball court
3. Boardwalk
4. Bridge (including suspension bridge over undulating land terrain)
5. Changing room
6. Covered walkway
7. Dog run
8. Drain
9. Gate
10. Gazebo
11. Green house
12. Mountain bicycle trail
13. Multi-purpose hard court
14. Park ranger’s office
15. Pavilion
16. Pergola
17. Pond, pool or fountain
18. Retaining wall (less than 1.8 m in height)
19. Screen
20. Sculpture
21. Shelter
22. Signage
23. Tennis court
24. Toilet
25. Tree house
26. Trellis
27. Underground shelter
28. Underpass within a park
29. Vegetation plot
30. Vertical planting frame.
[G.N. No. S 127/2004]
